name: Towards Tomorrow's Joy
source:
The "merging" has joined our world with the realm of the supernatural, and the ensuing fallout proves to be more than most can handle. Play as a human who has just joined a small community of survivors, a mixed community of humans and youkai, struggling to get by in the midst of conflict and confusion. 

[From [url=https://eudaemonics.itch.io/towards-tomorrows-joy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这种“融​​合”已经将我们的世界与超自然领域结合在一起，随之而来的后果被证明超出了大多数人的承受能力。扮演一个刚刚加入幸存者小社区的人类，这是一个人类和妖怪的混合社区，在冲突和混乱中挣扎求存。

[来自[url=https://eudaemonics.itch.io/towards-tomorrows-joy]itch.io[/url]]
